sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Constrain every selected local-frame node to nltl:structuralMember (and retain nltl:localFrame) before applying nltl:structuralLocation, nltl:midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, and nltl:hasStructuralMemberLoadCase, whose declared owner is structuralMember; do not apply these properties to an untyped localFrame. Remove sh:minCount 1 on hasStructuralMemberLoadCase: the requirement's every-load-case demand/orientation rules do not independently require that a load case exist. rows: Restrict the StructuralMemberShape and LoadCaseShape property constraints to applicable nltl:localFrame members and their load cases; as written, they validate structuralLocation, transverseFrameOrientation, load-case demand, and quantity structure for unrelated structural members and cases. For each bottom-frame load case, enforce that every asserted nltl:loadPatchOrientation value is nltl:loadPatchHeightParallelToFrame, not merely that one such value exists; remove the unrelated frameProfileType constraint unless it is separately required by this rule.

Add a direct per-applicable-load-case comparison of combinedShearAndBendingDemand to the ship-owned plasticStrength in a common validated unit; comparing demand only to midspanPlasticCollapseLoad is not equivalent when the strength/collapse relation permits tolerance. Also encode the declared ship-owned frameProfileType relationship from the COMPLETE dependency contract.

Constrain every selected local-frame node to nltl:structuralMember (and retain nltl:localFrame) before applying nltl:structuralLocation, nltl:midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, and nltl:hasStructuralMemberLoadCase, whose declared owner is structuralMember; do not apply these properties to an untyped localFrame. Remove sh:minCount 1 on hasStructuralMemberLoadCase: the requirement's every-load-case demand/orientation rules do not independently require that a load case exist. Keep the bounded comparison and bottom-case orientation violations conditional on actual linked load cases.
